licence: OANC licence (permissive: free to use, modify and share) for the MultiNLI government, slate, telephone and travel genres, per the MultiNLI data statement (Williams, Nangia and Bowman 2018); the fiction genre is excluded because one of its works is CC BY-SA 3.0 and rows do not identify it
notes: MultiNLI 1.0 train split (nyu-mll/multi_nli @ da70db2af9d09693783c3320c4249840212ee221). Data statement: https://cims.nyu.edu/~sbowman/multinli/ and https://aclanthology.org/N18-1101/. Used genres: government, slate, telephone, travel; fiction excluded. Label from the 'label' field (0 entailment, 1 neutral, 2 contradiction); label -1 dropped; pairs whose premise or hypothesis has fewer than 3 words dropped; pairs whose premise or hypothesis text equals a dev-set one dropped; duplicate (premise, hypothesis) pairs dropped. Group key = promptID; split = sha256 hash of the group key; at most one pair per premise; equal label thirds per split. Premise and hypothesis keep their own wording (whitespace collapsed only).
